description: Printful has a fully public official regional product/variant price feed and an OAuth-protected v2 catalog API. The feed is a ZIP/CSV download, not captured XHR; authenticated API methods are implemented but await a token for live replay.

capabilities.title: Collect public product variants and regional supplier base prices for all eight supported markets
capabilities.note: The anonymous archive is linked from the official Help Center page and downloaded through a pinned 302 destination. Its eight regional CSVs expose product/variant IDs, options, dimensions, category, and Product Price. Product Price is supplier base price; shipping and taxes are separate. China's $ marker remains currency-null because the feed does not disambiguate it. The feed is not an XHR API.

capabilities.title: Search and page through catalog products with region and category/color filters
capabilities.blocker: OAuth token required by the documented catalog endpoint. No token was supplied; the no-credential API probe returned HTTP 401.

capabilities.title: Read catalog product details and paginated color/size variants
capabilities.blocker: OAuth token required by the documented catalog endpoints; live product/variant replay is pending.

capabilities.title: Collect paginated variant production/base prices by technique, production region, and explicit currency
capabilities.blocker: OAuth token required by the documented price endpoint; live price replay is pending.
capabilities.note: Price output preserves Printful's price/discounted_price pairs and currency. The amount depends on product variant, technique, placement and quantity. It is not the merchant's retail price; shipping and tax are excluded.

capabilities.title: Read paginated catalog categories
capabilities.blocker: OAuth token required by the documented category endpoint; live category replay is pending.

capabilities.title: Use an OAuth token for Printful catalog API calls
capabilities.blocker: No token was supplied in this read-only task. Public Help-linked regional feed remains usable without this API credential; no account enrollment was attempted.

capabilities.title: Create or modify a store product, order, or account setting
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested product lookup and price collection only; account and store mutations are outside scope.
